fidelity_and_use_rules: The Library did not return a complete verbatim chat transcript; this manifest records the full recovered ZIP progression and named GPR specification artifacts available at retrieval time.
ZIPs are historical research artifacts; official docs, addresses, licenses, deployment status, quotas and source entitlements must be refreshed before implementation.
All pair seeds and V4 graph edges are research-only; no automatic execution permissions.
Do not treat version counts as unique totals; preserve source IDs, candidate IDs, chain and representation distinctions.
Do not import historical tokenized-equity/RWA stock ideas: current user policy excludes Robinhood Stock Tokens, xStocks and tokenized equities.
Never overwrite current canonical code owners with legacy ZIP prototypes.
